title: Exact Compositional Transfer of Bounded Linear Recovery
description: Exact labelled composition of bounded linear recovery, with coefficient witnesses and a stronger target-touching-distance theorem preserving minimal supports, arbitrary-law reliability, fractional service regions, and integral support allocations. Quotient-labelled lifting unifies prescribed operations in nested code pairs; support antichains and weighted prices retain operational choices, and fixed-query boundary width bounds composition work. A bilinear worker-task example illustrates the extension. The separately developed Ergodis system provides related compilation and verification interfaces. The Lean companion establishes only the associated-pair exact sequence; the stronger results have human proofs.
